pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"Measure visit: the check-in code at the door. Each install day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Showroom: the code at the desk.","at_the_visit":"The estimator measures, lifts a carpet corner in a closet to see what's under it, and brings samples; the customer picks the floor; the written quote follows the next business day","outside_visits":"Anyone from outside the team (the lab tester, a removal company) is named to the customer ahead, so they aren't turned away at the door; the owner marks their visit done","changes":"Hidden damage under the old floor, like a soft subfloor, is priced by a written change order with photos, signed by both before the fix. pluginText.pf.staff: {"roles":"Estimator (Danny): measure visits, quotes and running the job. Crew lead (Hugo): installs with the crew, board repairs and recoats; he can measure too. Floor consultants (Elena, Leo) at the showroom.","licenses":"The company holds the license or registration. Where the state's form also licenses each installer or salesperson, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie).","lead_safe":"A certified renovator on each install in an older home whenever painted parts are disturbed, where lead-safe rules apply. A crew without one isn't scheduled for those days.","outside":"The lab tester and any removal company aren't on the team: no texts from Rosie, no check-in code","who_oks":"Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins","stand_in":"Sam or another estimator may take a measure visit; a job keeps its estimator unless Sam moves it; only Elena does specialty work at the showroom"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written contract for an install where the state's rules require one (often above an amount), signed by everyone on title and by the business before any money","contract_parts":"The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien or homestead notice), with special-order material listed apart and the outside tester named","cancel_window":"A cancel window after a contract signed at the home, where the state's rules give one; the test, orders and work wait for it; a cancel in it gets a full refund in the time the rules set","sale_at_home":"Goods sold at the home get the cancel notice the rules require, even with no install","change_orders":"Written, priced and signed by both before the changed work","subcontractors":"A list of subcontractors and suppliers before work starts, where the state's rules require it","lien_release":"A lien release with the last payment, where the state's rules provide one","show":"The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it","warranty":"2 years on the install (the example's); the maker's warranty on the finish; a care guide","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"asbestos_found":"The business never removes it. The customer picks: cover it (no sanding or leveling, a new price by change order), a licensed removal company first, or cancel with a full refund. Nothing is touched or ordered meanwhile. Rosie's rule.","too_damp":"The crew waits, the install days move, and nothing is added to the price. Rosie's rule.","hidden_damage":"A soft or water-damaged subfloor: a change order with photos before the fix; wood never goes over it","backorder":"Special-order wood is late: new install dates only with the customer's OK; no reply in 2 days, the owner calls","cancel_after_window":"Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own","over_license_limit":"Not quoted, and the owner is told why","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last payment waits","nobody_home":"Lockbox install days with start and end photos","weather":"Garage floor sealing: the forecast is checked the day before (cold or damp air)","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
